dataList.content:
Something's going on outside.
外面有骚动。

Not long after Saude paused over Outis's remark, a grating speaker whine rang out, followed by the worried voice of the bearer on the other end.
索德的话音刚落，就听见似乎是轿内的扬声器发出的“嘟嘟”响声。

W-we're under attack!
是、是袭击！

Mm~ I thought things were going a little too easy. It's no surprise that other candidates are trying to eliminate us just in case.
嗯~本以为事情进展顺利，但看来还是有些想要妨碍各位的候选人呢。

<... Why am I not surprised?>
<事到如今，倒也没什么好惊讶的了……>
